svg.aria-label: Replay an editing trace, in memory. The automerge-perf trace: 259,778 keystrokes of a real paper (182,315 inserts, 77,463 deletes) replayed into one text as an editor would send them, the text read back whole at the end. Nothing touches the disk. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: TinyBase (no text that merges by position); PouchDB (no text that merges by position); RxDB (no text that merges by position); Fireproof (no text that merges by position); GUN (needs its storage adapter to answer in Node.js); OrbitDB (no text that merges by position).
